message: You know, preparing for a storm feels a bit like trying to herd cats — or, in my case, grandkids. They’re more interested in building a fort than discussing emergency supplies! But I’ve found that having a solid plan laid out can help keep the chaos at bay when the winds kick up. It’s a good reminder that a little preparation goes a long way. Have you ever had to convince your little ones about the importance of being ready for a rainy day, literally? ☔
